title: A Smaller Checked Presentation of iPRA
status: Research construction with written proofs and reproducible finite checks; no claim of absolute minimality

mathematical_result.formula_language: Full native Eq/D formulas, before the compact guarded public embedding
mathematical_result.precondition: The scalar predecessor has already been derived internally using literal-equation induction
proofs: Native universal introduction, with eigenvariable fresh for the context and fixed parameters
Native universal elimination at every term
Equivalence to the inherited universal macro and preservation of both formula interpretation composites
Whole-domain bi-interpretation with full first-order iPRA, using actual equality and identity numerical composite graphs x=y
mathematical_result.translated_rank: Exactly ordinary logical depth for the specified translator

size_example.family: F_n := forall x_0 ... forall x_(n-1) (T_n = S0), where T_n is scalar addition starting at 0
size_example.counting: Fully expanded raw trees; each variable, zero, S, I, equality, and D occurrence counts once; binder names are annotations
excluded: Further embedding into the compact guarded public grammar
Serialized proof certificates and proof-generation costs
size_example.qualification: New trees are larger at n=1 and n=2; the new expansion is smaller from n=3 in this family

mathematical_result.general_translation_bound: 6*N**2 + 104*N over the explicitly expanded scalar source language
mathematical_result.novelty_scope: Improvement over the inspected pinned main logical interfaces; no literature-wide originality claim

checker_results.normalization: Remove genuine docstrings, ast.unparse, append one LF

checker_results.truth_return_mechanism: Inherited from ConciseIPRA Article ch11_cert, Proposition cert:prop:truthy; composed here with the latest context-first control
